semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: 'text data augmentation' is a type of data augmentation, as it involves generating new text examples to improve model training.

parent_domains.justification: 'text data augmentation' is a subset of data augmentation as it specifically focuses on augmenting text data rather than other types like images or audio.

closest_parent_domain.justification: 'Data augmentation' is the overarching category under which 'text data augmentation' falls, as it covers all types of data augmentation including for text.

closest_child_domain.justification: There are no child domains of 'text data augmentation' listed, as all domains are either equivalent or unrelated to 'text data augmentation'.

sibling_domains.justification: 'Medical data augmentation' is a sibling to 'text data augmentation' as both are specific instances of 'data augmentation' applied to different data types.
This is a specific application of data augmentation similar to 'text data augmentation' because both apply augmentation strategies to specific types of data.
While not exactly the same, diagnosing classifiers might require similar augmentation strategies to those applied in textual data contexts.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: 'Medical data augmentation' is a specific domain under data augmentation, similar to 'text data augmentation', focusing on medical data rather than text.

unrelated_domains.justification: 'Text-to-image' is an unrelated domain as it focuses on generating images from text descriptions, rather than augmenting text data.
